text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co said its analyst Tim Savageaux raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for Harmonic Lightwaves Inc to $0.63/shr from $0.60. He also established a fiscal 1998 estimate of $0.85/shr.
-- On Wednesday, the company reported first quarter earnings of $0.18 a share on sales of $19 million versus $0.06 a share on sales of $11 million one year ago.

-- In a statement Savageaux said he believes there is upside potential to his 1997 and 1998 estimates based on stronger than expected digital product ramp-up and a faster cable television build up for cable modems.
